_readme: Vitest tests that were already failing when CI was turned back on (NodeCanvas refactor P0.06; FINDINGS F-62, F-69).
scripts/check-known-failures.mjs (npm run test:ci) fails CI on any failure NOT listed here, and on any entry here that no longer fails.
This list only shrinks: when you fix one, delete its entry in the same commit (npm run test:ci -- --prune).
Never add an entry to get a red build green. "(whole file failed to run)" marks a file that errors before any test runs.
seededFrom: refactor/wave2-integration @ b2314ce, 2026-09-23: 67 failing tests in 15 files (the F-69 set), plus UniverseManager.test.jsx failing at file level
